login.subtitle: Sign in to the school dashboard
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.refusedParent: Parents use the SchoolDimes mobile app, not this dashboard.
login.refusedStaff: This account can't use the web dashboard. Canteen and merchant staff use the POS app; parents use the mobile app.
login.whoFor: For school administrators, platform staff and students (student portal).

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Today, {date} (Africa/Kampala)
overview.staleHint: No sync within the school's stale limit
overview.booksHint: Every wallet in the school sums to zero
overview.simulatorNote: Until real POS devices are in use, sales, shortfalls and attendance come from the backend's simulate_pos command.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: From the ledger: every figure traces to POS transactions and their ledger entries.
sales.grossHint: Amount rung up at the till
sales.noItems: No line items were sent with this sale.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.subtitle: One Kampala day. POS figures are for transactions synced that day, when their ledger entries were written.
recon.traceNote: Every amount next to a ledger amount is recomputed from the ledger entries carrying its reference. Sum of every wallet in the school:
recon.clearingNote: The aggregator clearing wallet is normally negative: it is money the payment aggregator owes the school.

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Offline sales that synced with a shortfall or broke a policy rule. Nothing is dropped: decide what happens here.
review.simulatorNote: Until real devices exist, this queue is filled by the backend's simulate_pos command.
review.resHelp_accept: No money moves. The flag is acknowledged and the sale stays as recorded.
review.resHelp_write_off: No money moves. The school (or merchant) absorbs the outstanding amount.
review.resHelp_recover_from_next_topup: Takes what the student's main wallet holds now, then collects from every later confirmed top-up until the shortfall is repaid.
review.resHelp_charge_guardian: Same as recovery, plus a payment request for the outstanding amount is sent to the primary guardian's phone.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Computed on request from POS line items and the ledger. Rejected sales are excluded.
analytics.nutritionNote: Nutrition flag: share of item revenue in categories this school marks as unhealthy (Products page). Sales sent without line items aren't in this breakdown.
analytics.pickStudentHint: Choose a student to see their spending in this period.

student.overrideBy: Student override last set by {who} ({role}) on {when}. Parents can only tighten school limits.
student.unlinkHelp: {parent} will no longer see or manage {student}'s wallet, card or history. Their account is not deleted.
student.linkHelp: The parent registers in the SchoolDimes app first. Enter the exact email of their account.
student.linkConfirm: {parent} will be able to see {student}'s balances and history, top up, set spending limits and freeze the card.
student.noActiveCard: This student has no usable card.
student.ledgerHelp: The append-only ledger. Balances are the sum of these entries; nothing is ever edited or deleted.
student.portalHelp: Optional read-only portal where the student sees their balance, savings goals and recent purchases. The physical card stays the main way students pay.
student.portalPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters. Give it to the student privately.
student.portalCreateHelp: Creates a read-only student login for {name}. It can never see other students.
student.portalRemoveHelp: The student will no longer be able to sign in to the portal. Their wallet and card are unaffected.

cards.title: Cards
cards.subtitle: Issue, freeze, replace and reset PINs. Changes reach POS devices on their next cache refresh.
cards.uidFormat: Card UID format: the NFC tag's bytes as lowercase hex with no separators, e.g. 04:A2:2B:7C:91:3E:80 is stored as 04a22b7c913e80. Read it with the POS app's dev "show UID" helper, or any NFC reader app.
cards.uidHelp: Tap the card on a reader and type its UID. Leave blank to let the server generate one (no physical card).
cards.uidInvalid: Must be 4–32 bytes of hex, e.g. 04:A2:2B:7C
cards.uidBlank: No UID: the server generates one (for testing without a physical card).
cards.pinHelp: 4 to 6 digits. It is hashed at once and never shown again.
cards.reissueWarning: The old card ({uid}) stays retired as lost. The new card gets a new UID and PIN.
cards.freezeHelp: Every purchase, transfer and fee payment from {name}'s card is refused at once. Offline POS devices refuse it after their next cache refresh. Guardians are notified.
cards.unfreezeHelp: {name}'s card can be used again. Guardians are notified.
cards.resetPinHelp: The old PIN stops working. POS devices pick up the new PIN on their next refresh. A card frozen after wrong PINs stays frozen until you unfreeze it.
cards.markLostHelp: Permanent: {name}'s card can never be used again. Issue a replacement afterwards.

guardians.title: Guardians & KYC
guardians.subtitle: Identity checks (KYC-lite) for parents linked to your students, and all guardian links.
guardians.reviewHelp: Check the parent's {doc} number {number} against the document they show you.
guardians.linkHint: To link or unlink a guardian, open the student.
